audit_scope: SaathiOS voice implementation at mission start

details: The global VoiceOutputProvider, VoiceRuntimeProvider, and their docks were mounted in Shell, but no /settings/voice route existed.
The general Settings page, command palette, profile/mobile surface, onboarding, and chat voice help contained no Voice Settings destination.
Chat had a separate VoiceControl reachable only after opening the chat voice panel.
The legacy /voice route is an enrollment page, not a general preference or diagnostics page.
No role gate or voice feature flag was the primary cause, and the served private-alpha browser reported both speech synthesis and recognition APIs.

storage.scope: browser profile, not server user record
storage.corruption_behavior: JSON parse failure and malformed fields fall back to bounded defaults.

implementations.architecture: Authenticated local platform SpeechService creates bounded audio artifacts; the enabled macOS system provider invokes /usr/bin/say. Browser playback remains explicit.
implementations.network: Loopback Saathi platform API only. No external speech provider is configured by this mission.
implementations.persistence: Speech operations and temporary server artifacts follow existing SpeechService lifecycle; client preferences persist in browser storage.

implementations.architecture: Browser speechSynthesis with runtime-discovered voices filtered to localService=true.
implementations.network: No Saathi API request and no external provider request is made by the settings playback test.
implementations.persistence: Only bounded non-sensitive preferences persist. Phrase text and playback state remain in page memory.

implementations.architecture: Explicit getUserMedia plus browser SpeechRecognition, then transcript submission to the loopback platform voice-runtime API.
implementations.network: Transcribed text is sent to the local Saathi platform. Browser SpeechRecognition processing locality is controlled by the browser and is not claimed local.
implementations.persistence: Existing voice-runtime sessions and transcripts may be persisted by the local platform. MediaStream tracks are released on stop, route change, context/logout, error, and provider cleanup.

implementations.architecture: User-initiated getUserMedia and browser SpeechRecognition with an in-memory transcript preview and editable text fallback.
implementations.network: SaathiOS does not upload settings-test audio or transcript. Browser recognition service locality cannot be guaranteed by SaathiOS.
implementations.persistence: No audio or transcript persistence. Acquired tracks are stopped after permission probing, stop, recognition end/error, navigation, or context/logout.

implementations.architecture: Browser SpeechRecognition and speechSynthesis with transcript turns submitted to the existing local Voice OS/ChatEngine bridge.
implementations.network: Loopback chat/voice API plus browser-dependent recognition behavior.
implementations.persistence: Local voice sessions/transcript turns may persist in the existing chat path. This is separate from the settings test.
implementations.interruption: Recognition-result interruption only; not full acoustic barge-in.

implementations.architecture: MediaRecorder-based five-second enrollment submitted to the existing local enrollment API.
implementations.network: Loopback API only in the inspected implementation.
implementations.persistence: Enrollment is designed to persist a voice profile; it is not used as the new preference surface and is not newly promoted in navigation.

implementations.reason: The certified browser reported no local ne-* system voice. Nepali phrase text is visible, but playback is refused rather than mislabeled supported.
Output is stopped by explicit controls or microphone-start/recognition events; no continuous acoustic barge-in detector exists.
No external provider, paid API, provider credential, or cloud speech connection was enabled.
